title: Federated Edge-Cloud Resilience Architecture for Distributed Campus Networks Using Quantized Sequence Autoencoders and Multi-Agent DRL Control
description: Research artifact for IEEE RIVF 2026 paper introducing a decentralized Federated Edge-Cloud resilience framework combining PyTorch INT8 TCN-GRU autoencoders with FedAvg parameter aggregation and Multi-Agent DRL SDN control.
